observations.measurement_context: (2) Gas permeability was measured by a porometer (CFP-1500-AEL manufactured by PMI Co., Ltd). Gas permeability was usually expressed by Gurley number. However, relative difference of permeability depending upon pore structure of the film cannot be noticed by Gurley number, because the effect of film thickness has not been implied. In order to solve the problem, the present invention employs Darcy's permeability constant, which is obtained from Equation 1. C =(8 F T V )/(π D 2 ( P 2 −1)   <Equation 1>
